purpose: Mobile-only app release: iPhone and Android phones only; PC and tablet show a mobile-access notice; dedicated PC/tablet source remains preserved in archive branch; mobile-only QA must pass before protected Production promotion
last_retry_reason: The white-screen patch and focused tests passed. The release script's changed-file allowlist was narrowed too far: its existing next step deliberately adds the mobile-first stylesheet import to src/main.js, so the legitimate change set is index.html plus src/main.js. Updated the allowlist to those two files only; PC/tablet CSS, scripts, startup and platform entry remain untouched.
